utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh sure, I’ll swing by and check what’s still on the list, then I’ll let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—thanks, Tess. Check the list first, then let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll stop by and ask what’s still on the list, then I’ll let you know so you can pass it along after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s gather the tools first, then head into the repair drive. I can bring my basic tools and help for a couple hours this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great, Bo—your tools and a couple hours will really help. I’ll spread the word and see if anyone else can pitch in too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—thanks, Jules. Just let me know what time and where to bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations today. If you stop by, I’ll remind you about the supply run too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is it really picking up more donations today? If so, I can stop by and check the supply run too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Kira — I’d really appreciate it. If you swing by, I’ll fill you in on the supply run and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup if that makes the repair drive easier. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That would help a lot. Let’s aim for mid-morning, after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mid-morning works for me after drop-off. I’ll plan around that and let you know if pickup timing becomes an issue.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donated tools by size and set them aside.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a big help, Sam—thanks. Who’s coordinating the pickup and drop-off so we know how to get everything there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check with Leo and see who’s coordinating it, then I’ll pass along the pickup and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll be there at 3 to move the boxes and keep an eye out for spare parts. Just point me to the pile when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Oren — I’ll make sure the neighbors hear the repair drive details clearly. Thanks for helping with the boxes and spare parts at 3.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, thanks Vik — I’ll be there at 3 and ready to help with the boxes and any spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m still missing a few things, so if you hear back from Cleo, let me know and I’ll make the rest work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — a simple list and 3 works for me. I’ll let you know if I hear from Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it simple and aim for 3. Let me know if Cleo turns anything up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring over the wrench set and screwdriver for the repair drive—just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that’s really helpful. I’ll keep an ear out for any other needs and pass along updates if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—happy to help. Just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I’ve got it right—are we gathering tools first, or going straight to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think we’re gathering the tools first, then heading to the repair drive. Sorry, I might need a reminder if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—tools first, then the repair drive. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got on hand for the repair drive—what supplies do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—if we’ve got any tape, spare screws, glue, and a few basic tools, that’d be a big help. I’ll keep spreading the word either way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and see what I can round up for the repair drive—tape, screws, glue, and a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the small fixes, then—patching leaks and replacing broken boards. Thanks for asking, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—small fixes first, like leaks and broken boards. What location should I note next for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Let’s note the community shed by Maple and 3rd. It’s the easiest spot for folks to find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, just not too much. Keep me posted and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — I’ll keep you posted. It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and any help you can give would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can swing by for a little while and help where I can, just need to keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a little worried about the logistics—who’s handling the pickup and drop-off? Once those roles are clear, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll handle the pickup tomorrow afternoon, and we can sort drop-off once the tools are in hand. Thanks for helping—I'll keep it simple and make sure we get to the repair drive after that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot—thanks, Mara. Once you’ve got the tools, just let me know the drop-off plan and I’ll help from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — if there’s a list of the biggest repairs, I can help with those first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll repeat the repair drive details to the neighbors and point out the biggest repairs first so everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Vik. I can take the biggest repairs first once you share the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first—what time does the repair drive start, and which items are they accepting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure of the exact start time yet, but I can find out. I know they’re taking donated tools and repair supplies, and I can check on the full list too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please check the start time and full list, and I’ll hold off until we know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I can swing by the repair drive and check what’s still needed. I’ll let you know the latest once I’ve had a look.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted on what’s still needed. I can bring my basic tools and help for a couple hours this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great—I’ll head over and see what’s still on the list, then I’ll let you know what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—I'll swing by tomorrow afternoon. Do you need me to bring anything back from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nope, that’s all good — just bring the tools back when you’re done, and we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the tools back when I’m done. See you tomorrow afternoon, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note Sunday at the community center and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that really helps. I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can help a little if it stays low-key. Just keep me posted on the updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep you posted on any updates. If I stop by, you might need to remind me about the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem — just remind me too, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—send me the flyers and details, and I’ll get the word out right away. I’ll keep you posted if I hear any updates for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. If I hear anything on my errands, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Ira—send anything you hear my way and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I can still help move the boxes around at 3, and I’ll keep an eye out for any spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that would be a big help. I’ll sort the tools by size and set them aside for 3.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll be there at 3 and help move the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we’ve got on hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — we’re good on my end for 8:30, and I can come by after school drop-off. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, 8:30 works—I'll have the supplies sorted by then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s actually going well, then? If they’re still taking tools and supplies, I can bring something useful this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, that would help a lot—tools and basic supplies are still useful. If you can, bring whatever’s in good condition this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, you still need tools and basic supplies in good condition this weekend, right?
